content: ˚न्यायः The rule according to which the नित्यकर्मन्s (which are to be performed यावज्जीवम्) are performed at their stipulated or scheduled time only, during oneʼs life time. This is discussed and established by जैमिनि and शबर at <ls>Ms. 6. 2. 23-26</ls> in connection with अग्निहोत्र and other कर्मन्s.
